name: ai-planner
description: **A privacy-focused PWA that digitizes handwritten planner pages using Google Gemini 2.0 Flash.**

scripts.test:e2e: cd e2e && npx playwright test tests/sync.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: cd e2e && CI=true npx playwright test tests/sync.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:ui: cd e2e && npx playwright test tests/ui.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:full: firebase emulators:exec 'cd e2e && npx playwright test --project=chromium'
scripts.quality:ci: npm run check:conflicts && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e:smoke
